text:
Zoe: Short thread: we need a crisp decision for the Console form patterns before the next rollout. Focus areas: compact error surfaces (chips vs full inline), required-field affordance in tables vs forms, and canonical delete guardrails (undo snackbar vs typed confirm). Keep replies short and practical.

Ivy: Compact chips are great for dense rows (lists, table inline edits). They should expand on focus to reveal the full message and include an accessible name. For standard forms use full inline blocks.

Theo: Proposal: rule-of-thumb -> use chips when the row height < 48px or when errors would push layout by more than one line. Otherwise inline error blocks.

Sam: Accessibility note: chips must still be announced. Use aria-describedby from the field to the expanded error container and ensure the expanded message has role=alert.

Mina: Required markers: tables get a small column header "Req" (aria-label="Required column"); individual inputs get a visual '*' plus an sr-only "Required" span. Avoid color-only signals.

Ivy: Also suggest a user preference (Settings) to opt-in to verbose helpers - shows visible "Required" text everywhere for new users. Keeps defaults tidy.

Theo: Delete flow: single-item -> inline confirm + undo snackbar (8s). Bulk -> modal showing scope + count and preview (max 5). Permanent -> typed confirm using resource-id (not display name) and require exact match.

Sam: Edge-case: snackbar disappear on slow networks/mobile. Always provide a Trash/Activity recovery path for 30 days and surface a "View Trash" link in the toast. Analytics: track undo clicks and restore-from-trash.

Mina: Microcopy candidates:
- Undo toast: "Moved to Trash — Undo"
- Bulk toast: "Deleted 6 items. Restore from Trash within 30 days. View Trash"
- Typed confirm label: "Type the resource id to permanently delete: my-project-42"

Zoe: Good. Quick a11y checklist to include in the pattern doc:
- Inline errors: input uses aria-invalid, message uses role=alert and links via aria-describedby.
- Error chips: expanded panel role=alert; chip has aria-controls to the message and is keyboard-focusable.
- Top summary (for long/multi-step forms): focus it, role=alert, and provide anchor links that call element.focus() then smooth-scroll.
- Required markers: aria-required on inputs and sr-only text when using '*'.

Theo: Implementation notes for Eng: server errors should include an array like `[{field: "email", message: "Invalid", anchorId: "#email"}]` so client can render top-summary anchors. Also send severity (validation|server|fatal) to decide chip vs block.

Ivy: Action items: Theo will add the chip vs inline threshold + code snippets. Mina will compile microcopy variants and the user-pref mock. Sam will add the a11y snippets and examples. I'll create the pattern doc and link PR.

design-bot: Created task "forms/compact-errors-required-badges-delete-guards" -> /design-system/issues/821.

Zoe: Target doc draft by Wednesday EOD. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
